candidate.title: Multi-organ metabolome biological age implicates cardiometabolic conditions and mortality risk.
candidate.abstract: Multi-organ biological aging clocks across different organ systems have been shown to predict human disease and mortality. Here, we extend this multi-organ framework to plasma metabolomics, developing five organ-specific metabolome-based biological age gaps (MetBAGs) using 107 plasma non-derivatized metabolites from 274,247 UK Biobank participants. Our age prediction models achieve a mean absolute error of approximately 6 years (0.25 -8 /5). Using SBayesS, we estimate the SNP-based heritability (0.09< hSNP2  < 0.18), negative selection signatures (-0.93 < S < -0.76), and polygenicity (0.001<Pi < 0.003) for the 5 MetBAGs. Genetic correlation and Mendelian randomization analyses reveal potential causal links between the 5 MetBAGs and cardiometabolic conditions (e.g., metabolic disorders and hypertension). Integrating multi-organ and multi-omics features improves disease category and mortality predictions. The 5 MetBAGs extend existing biological aging clocks to study human aging and disease across multiple biological scales. All results are publicly available at https://labs-laboratory.com/medicine/ .
candidate.authors: MULTI consortium, Anagnostakis F, Ko S, Saadatinia M, Wang J, Davatzikos C, Wen J.

extraction.method: Lasso与神经网络构建5个器官特异性MetBAG
extraction.data: UKBB 274247人，107个血浆非衍生代谢物
extraction.scenario: 多器官代谢组衰老与疾病风险
extraction.benchmark: PhenoBAG、ProtBAG、脑MRI BAG等既往衰老时钟
extraction.results: 独立测试Pearson r 0.25–0.42；关联525个疾病终点；预测14类疾病与死亡风险
extraction.availability: 结果与预训练模型公开于MEDICINE门户
extraction.limitations: 代谢物覆盖有限；预测相关性中等；需跨人群验证
extraction.summary: 利用UK Biobank 274247人的107个血浆代谢物开发5个器官特异性代谢组生物年龄MetBAG。采用Lasso和神经网络建模，并进行年龄偏差校正、GWAS、遗传相关和因果分析。发现MetBAG及其PRS与多种疾病和死亡风险相关，模型和结果已公开。
